Title: Global Knowledge Senior Data Analyst

Working closely with the Global Knowledge Sr. Manager , this role prepares, structures, analyzes, and translates customer, product, market, operational, and knowledge data into actionable insights that improve customer experience, support regional growth, and enable new business opportunities. The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations. What You’ll Do (Impact Areas) Data Analysis & Business Insights Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness. Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities. Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making. Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance. Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness. Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact. Data Products & Value Creation Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions. Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions. Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential. Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value. Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data. Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements. Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes. Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions. AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities. Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support. Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities. Business & Technology Partnership Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements. Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions. Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner. Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes. Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products. Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions. Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation. Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value. What Success Looks Like Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases. Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making. Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance. Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions. AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity. Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams. Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth. Core Competencies Data analysis and analytical thinking. Business intelligence and data visualization. Data storytelling and executive communication. Business requirements gathering and translation. Problem-solving and root cause analysis. Data quality and governance. AI and digital technology awareness. Customer-centric thinking. Cross-functional collaboration. Stakeholder management and influence. Business and commercial acumen. Continuous improvement mindset. Project coordination and execution. Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity. Required What You Bring (Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions. Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources. Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements. Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment. Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools. Preferred Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives. Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions. Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation. Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments. Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics. Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants. Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations. Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products. Work Model & Travel Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements. Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization. Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs. Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams. Our Commitment to You Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of a global, AI-enabled Knowledge Management capability. Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products. Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions. Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders. A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable business impact. Title: Supply Chain Data Analyst
Industries: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing and Plastics Manufacturing
Description: Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility? Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere. Main Responsibilities Analyze and monitor Supply Chain data to identify operational issues, trends, and opportunities for process improvement. Support daily SAP transactions and troubleshoot system-related issues across Supply Chain planning processes. Investigate and resolve IDOC errors to ensure accurate and timely data integration between systems. Manage and support COGI transactions, identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions with cross-functional teams. Perform data analysis and reporting to support inventory management, production planning, logistics, and order fulfillment activities. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Customer Service teams to improve data accuracy and process efficiency. Support and optimize business processes within SAP, primarily in the MM (Materials Management), PP (Production Planning), and SD (Sales & Distribution) modules. Develop dashboards, reports, and KPIs to provide visibility into Supply Chain performance and support decision-making. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and system enhancement projects. Required Profile Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field. Previous experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Production Planning, or related areas. Hands-on experience working with SAP, specifically within MM, PP, and SD modules. Practical experience with IDOC monitoring and resolution and COGI transaction management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret and manage large datasets. Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal) required. Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with reporting and data visualization tools is a plus. Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently. At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward. Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry. Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions. With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

Description: Descripción de puesto Administrar los proyectos de FESM, EURUS y TEG en el esquema de autoabasto y de Tuli,Helios y Menkent en el esquema del Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista (MEM) con base en sus contratos con terceros, CENACE, CRE y CFE, brindando soporte y atención de calidad a clientes externos y a Cemex México. Principales responsabilidades Entrega mensual/trimestral a CFE ICL de información relacionada con la asignación de potencia y energía. Entrega mensual y trimestral de reportes a CENACE y CFE. Validaciones de resultados mensuales de reparto de energía y potencia a nivel punto de carga proporcionados por CFE ICL. Generación, validación y envío de estados de cuenta a socios terceros y Cemex México. Aclaración de dudas de los estados de cuenta a clientes externos y a Cemex México. Aclaración de dudas y seguimiento a ajustes relacionados a facturas eléctricas de CFE de cargas representadas por EURUS, TEG y FESM ante CFE ICL. Análisis de asignación de energía y potencia en EURUS, TEG y FESM maximizando sus ganancias con base en los contratos establecidos con clientes externos, Acciona, CENACE y CFE ICL. Ejecutar procesos de reparto de energía y potencia a lo largo del mes, para la estimación de precios unitarios de energía, provisión de costos de clientes externos y a Cemex México, estimación de ganancias por ventas a terceros, ahorros versus CFE 100% en cargas de Cemex México, etc. Seguimiento a compromisos contractuales de entrega de energía a clientes externos. Efectuar el proceso de reparto de energía y entrega de reportes al equipo de BSO para la elaboración de facturas. Seguimiento de los compromisos contractuales de Tuli y Helios con CENACE, Cemex México y Menkent. Elaboración y entrega de los estados de cuenta mensuales y anuales del contrato de cobertura financiera celebrados entre Tuli y Helios con Cemex México. Elaboración y entrega de los estados de cuenta mensuales y anuales del contrato de cobertura de energía celebrados entre Tuli y Helios con Cemex México. Elaboración y entrega de los estados de cuenta mensuales y anuales de los contratos de CELs con CFE Calificados. Validación de estados de cuenta emitidos por CENACE a los generadores en el MEM. Entrega de ofertas de compra y venta de los generadores en el MEM. Generación, validación y envío de transacciones bilaterales en el MEM entre Tuli & Helios con los participantes del MEM. Realizar semanalmente el proceso de facturación, entregando toda la información necesaria al equipo de BSO (archivos planos) para la elaboración de facturas con adenda. Cargar en el Sistema de Información de Mercado “SIM” las facturas con adenda para la programación de pagos y cobros entre el CENACE y los generadores, para posteriormente reportarlo a BSO. Dar seguimiento de flujos semanales de pagos y cobros de Tuli & Helios con CENACE. Dar seguimiento a la REA para validar que las garantías proporcionadas por los participantes del MEM son suficientes para su operación. Retos del puesto Generación de modelos matemáticos para la predicción de diferentes variables (consumos, precios, etc) Maximización de ganancias Elaboración de análisis para determinar la asignación optima entre proyectos Adaptación a los cambios del CENACE, CRE y CFE Atención al cliente Habilidades y conocimientos requeridos Escolaridad Licenciatura: Ingeniería (Titulado) - Ing. Mecánico Electricista, Ing. Físico Industrial, Ing. Químico, Ing. en Energía, Ing. Industrial. Maestría (deseable): Preferentemente en Administración, Finanzas o afín a Energía. Dominio del Idioma Inglés: Avanzado. Experiencia Requerida 2+ años en áreas similares relacionadas a energía en los esquemas de Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista o Autoabasto, generación, renovables y facturación eléctrica. Preferente Conocimiento Requerido Análisis y manejo de datos. Dominio del paquete de Microsoft Office(Power BI, Excel Avanzado) Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista Facturación Eléctrica. Esquema de Autoabasto. Respetamos la diversidad, abordamos la inclusión y la no-discriminación de cualquier persona con talento, independientemente de su género, capacidad física, edad, orientación sexual, cultura, origen étnico, religión, afiliación política, estado civil, embarazo/maternidad/paternidad y nacionalidad.
